title: Poe gets Aipa panel approval for PH-Malaysia Asean AI resolution

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines— The Philippines and Malaysia secured approval of a merged resolution on strengthening parliamentary cooperation on artificial intelligence (AI) governance, scientific innovation, and ethical AI-driven growth in the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean). The resolution was approved on Thursday during the meeting of the Committee on Economic Matters at the 47th Asean Inter-Parliamentary Assembly (Aipa) General Assembly.
